If the raw value for a date-valued property is not a string,
warn and discard the value.

If the invalid raw is the only value for the property, as in this test,
discard the property.

-- test.glx --
citations:
    citation-with-error:
        properties:
            # accessed is a date-valued property and 3 is not a string.
            accessed: 3
    citation-well-formed:
        properties:
            accessed: "2022-01-19"

-- want-errors --
citations\[citation-with-error\].Properties.accessed: value discarded: expected date string, got int
citations\[citation-with-error\].Properties.accessed: entry discarded: has neither value nor fields
citations\[citation-with-error\].Properties.accessed: property discarded: no entries

-- want-catalog.yaml --
citations:
    citation-with-error:
        properties: {} # Ill-formed property discarded.
    citation-well-formed:
        properties:
            accessed:
                definition:
                    label: Accessed Date
                    value_type: date
                entries:
                -   value: "2022-01-19"
